items.title: What Does Edison International (EIX) Extending Wildfire Claims To 2026 Mean?
items.summary: Edison International (NYSE:EIX) unit Southern California Edison has extended its wildfire recovery compensation deadline to December 31, 2026. The extension targets residents and property owners affected by the Eaton Fire who are still preparing documentation for claims. Southern California Edison cited sustained participation in the recovery program as a key reason for lengthening the compensation window.
